name: Liquid breeze
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 29
Price 30 gp; Weight —
Category Alchemical Remedies
Description
Developed in ancient times to ease travels across the harsh deserts of Kelesh, liquid breeze is a common ware in markets catering to travelers, adventurers, and explorers. This soothing liquid grants the benefits of endure elements for 8 hours, but only against hot environments. This effect is nonmagical and can’t be dispelled.
Construction
Craft (Alchemy) DC 20
